name: Meiping  Vase with Cloud Collars and Peony Sprays
material: porcelain with incised decoration and white glaze
dimensions: Diameter: 20.3 cm (8 in.); Overall: 32.1 cm (12 5/8 in.)
summary: This beautiful vase, called a meiping, is a testimony to the extremely high standards demanded for imperial white porcelain of the Yongle period.
